_about: Facts both halves of NekoServer use: the runtime builds this file in (common::SHARED), setup reads it (neko_common.SHARED). One copy, so the two can never disagree.

compose._about: What a Compose file may hold, as `docker compose config --format json` shows it. Anything else (use_api_socket, post_start/pre_stop hooks, secrets, configs, cap_add, a new key Docker adds later) is refused until NekoServer knows what it gives the app. Checked by maintenance.rs valid_model, for setup (check-compose) and the monthly update.
